summary: New York City, web developer, studied mathematics at NYU, open-source software advocate, creator of PHP framework, startup founder, interested in distributed social networks, passionate about privacy and user data control, engaged in technology and web design discussions, advocates for reducing software patents, believes in the importance of community and collaboration in tech, has experience with startup funding and entrepreneurship, enjoys hiking and outdoor activities, values mental health and personal development, has a history of early academic achievement (attended college at 14), interested in the intersection of technology and social issues.
